class StaticObservabilityCombinedAdmission(unittest.TestCase):
    def current(self):
        return (ROOT/READINESS_PATH).read_bytes()

    def test_exact_static_layer_restores_complete_published_r5_and_all_old_floors(self):
        data = self.current()
        restored = _static_observability_contract(_crop_static_contract(json.loads(data)))
        encoded = (json.dumps(restored, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
        self.assertEqual(digest(encoded), STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_PRECONTRACT_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(restored['feature_batch_support_sha256'][COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH],
                         STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_PREADMISSION_SHA256)
        for name, row in STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_SUPPORT.items():
            self.assertEqual(digest((ROOT/name).read_bytes()), row['after_sha256'])
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(data)['followon_support_sha256'][name], row['after_sha256'])
            self.assertEqual(restored['followon_support_sha256'][name], row['before_sha256'])
        combined = _compile_repair_combined_contract(restored)
        self.assertEqual(digest((json.dumps(combined, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()),
                         COMBINED_PRECOMPILE_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(digest(_combined_profile_contract(data)), PROFILE_R2_CONTRACT_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(digest(historical_readiness_contract(data)), ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256)

    def test_each_static_raw_drift_or_missing_file_is_rejected(self):
        data = self.current(); probe = ProfileMerchantCombinedAdmission()
        for name in STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_SUPPORT:
            path = ROOT/name; value = path.read_bytes()
            for mutant in [value+b'\n', value[:-1], b'\xef\xbb\xbf'+value,
                           value.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'), bytes([value[0]^1])+value[1:]]:
                with self.subTest(path=name), probe.substituted({str(path):mutant}), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    _combined_profile_contract(data)
            original = Path.read_bytes
            def missing(p):
                if p == path: raise FileNotFoundError(name)
                return original(p)
            with patch.object(Path, 'read_bytes', missing), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                _combined_profile_contract(data)

    def test_repinned_static_old_new_mixed_supports_and_unknown_fields_rejected(self):
        data = self.current(); probe = ProfileMerchantCombinedAdmission()
        for name, row in STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_SUPPORT.items():
            for mode in ['missing', 'old', 'forged']:
                changed = json.loads(data)
                if mode == 'missing': del changed['followon_support_sha256'][name]
                else: changed['followon_support_sha256'][name] = row['before_sha256'] if mode == 'old' else '0'*64
                with self.subTest(path=name, mode=mode): probe.reject_repinned(changed)
        for mode in ['unknown-top', 'unknown-followon', 'unknown-feature', 'old-self', 'missing-self']:
            changed = json.loads(data)
            if mode == 'unknown-top': changed['unreviewed_static_field'] = True
            elif mode == 'unknown-followon': changed['followon_support_sha256']['tools/unreviewed_static.py'] = '0'*64
            elif mode == 'unknown-feature': changed['feature_batch_support_sha256']['tools/unreviewed_static.py'] = '0'*64
            elif mode == 'old-self': changed['feature_batch_support_sha256'][COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH] = STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_PREADMISSION_SHA256
            else: del changed['feature_batch_support_sha256'][COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH]
            with self.subTest(mode=mode): probe.reject_repinned(changed)
        probe.reject_repinned(_static_observability_contract(_crop_static_contract(json.loads(data))))

    def test_repinned_new_static_raw_hashes_do_not_authorize_changed_sources(self):
        data = self.current(); probe = ProfileMerchantCombinedAdmission()
        for name in STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_SUPPORT:
            path = ROOT/name; mutant = path.read_bytes()+b'\n'
            changed = json.loads(data); changed['followon_support_sha256'][name] = digest(mutant)

    def test_static_preimages_and_self_preimage_are_bound_by_whole_r5_contract(self):

class CropStaticCombinedAdmission(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_exact_crop_layer_restores_frozen_static_and_all_old_floors(self):
        data = (ROOT/READINESS_PATH).read_bytes()
        restored = _crop_static_contract(json.loads(data))
        encoded = (json.dumps(restored, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
        self.assertEqual(digest(encoded), CROP_PRESTATIC_CONTRACT_SHA256)
        self.assertNotIn(CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH, restored['feature_batch_sources'])
        self.assertEqual(restored['feature_batch_support_sha256'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH],
                         CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_ROW['before_sha256'])
        self.assertEqual(restored['feature_batch_support_sha256'][COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH],
                         CROP_PRESTATIC_ADMISSION_SHA256)
        published = _static_observability_contract(restored)
        self.assertEqual(digest((json.dumps(published, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()),
                         STATIC_OBSERVABILITY_PRECONTRACT_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(digest(_combined_profile_contract(data)), PROFILE_R2_CONTRACT_SHA256)
        self.assertEqual(digest(historical_readiness_contract(data)), ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256)
        value = (ROOT/CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH).read_bytes()
        hunk = CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_ROW['hunks'][0]
        self.assertEqual(value.count(hunk['after'].encode()), 1)
        old = value.replace(hunk['after'].encode(), hunk['before'].encode(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(digest(old), CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_ROW['before_sha256'])
        self.assertEqual(re.findall(rb'(horizontal|vertical|zoom)=([0-9.]+)', value),
                         re.findall(rb'(horizontal|vertical|zoom)=([0-9.]+)', old))

    def test_repinned_crop_mixed_groups_unknown_fields_and_wrong_order_rejected(self):
        data = (ROOT/READINESS_PATH).read_bytes(); probe = ProfileMerchantCombinedAdmission()
        for mode in ['missing-row', 'missing-support', 'old-support', 'old-self', 'duplicate-hunk', 'unknown-hunk', 'unrelated']:
            changed = json.loads(data)
            if mode == 'missing-row': del changed['feature_batch_sources'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH]
            elif mode == 'missing-support': del changed['feature_batch_support_sha256'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH]
            elif mode == 'old-support': changed['feature_batch_support_sha256'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH] = CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_ROW['before_sha256']
            elif mode == 'old-self': changed['feature_batch_support_sha256'][COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH] = CROP_PRESTATIC_ADMISSION_SHA256
            elif mode == 'duplicate-hunk': changed['feature_batch_sources'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH]['hunks'] *= 2
            elif mode == 'unknown-hunk': changed['feature_batch_sources'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH]['hunks'][0]['before'] += ' '
            else: changed['unreviewed_crop_field'] = True
            with self.subTest(mode=mode): probe.reject_repinned(changed)
        probe.reject_repinned(_crop_static_contract(json.loads(data)))

    def test_crop_raw_drift_and_rehashed_mutations_remain_rejected(self):
        data = (ROOT/READINESS_PATH).read_bytes(); probe = ProfileMerchantCombinedAdmission()
        path = ROOT/CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH; value = path.read_bytes()
        hunk = CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_ROW['hunks'][0]
        for mutant in [value+b'\n', value.replace(hunk['after'].encode(), hunk['before'].encode(), 1),
                       value+hunk['after'].encode(), b'\xef\xbb\xbf'+value]:

                _combined_profile_contract(data)
            changed = json.loads(data)
            changed['feature_batch_sources'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH]['after_sha256'] = digest(mutant)
            changed['feature_batch_support_sha256'][CROP_COMPILE_REPAIR_PATH] = digest(mutant)
            encoded = (json.dumps(changed, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
            runnerpath = ROOT/'tools/run138_editor_readiness.py'
            runner = runnerpath.read_bytes().replace(digest(data).encode(), digest(encoded).encode(), 1)
            with probe.substituted({str(path):mutant, str(ROOT/READINESS_PATH):encoded, str(runnerpath):runner}), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                _combined_profile_contract(encoded)

    def test_crop_self_preimage_is_bound_by_complete_static_contract(self):
        data = (ROOT/READINESS_PATH).read_bytes()
        with patch.dict(globals(), {'CROP_PRESTATIC_ADMISSION_SHA256':'0'*64}), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Complete frozen static'):
            _crop_static_contract(json.loads(data))

    def setUp(self):
        self.life = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='native-static-output-')
        self.addCleanup(self.life.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.life.name)
        self.log = self.base / 'child.log'

    def start_wrapper(self, child):
        code = ('import os, sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n'
                'sys.path.insert(0, ' + repr(str(ROOT / 'tools')) + ')\n'
                'import run_static_checks as runner\n'
                'result = runner.run_logged_process(' + repr([sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '-c', child]) +
                ', Path.cwd(), dict(os.environ), Path(' + repr(str(self.log)) + '))\n'
                'print("CHILD_RETURN_CODE=" + str(result.returncode), flush=True)\n')
        process = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '-c', code],
                                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        self.addCleanup(finish_process, process)
        return process

    def test_tee_preserves_nonzero_exit_and_merged_bytes(self):
        process = self.start_wrapper('import os\nos.write(1, b"out\\n")\nos.write(2, b"err\\n")\nraise SystemExit(7)')
        output, _ = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 0, output)
        self.assertEqual(self.log.read_bytes(), b'out\nerr\n')
        self.assertEqual(output, self.log.read_bytes() + b'CHILD_RETURN_CODE=7\n')

    def test_tee_retries_short_console_writes_without_losing_bytes(self):
        class ShortWriter(io.BytesIO):
            def write(self, value):
                return super().write(value[:3])
        output = ShortWriter()
        console = mock.Mock(buffer=output)
        command = [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '-c', 'import os; os.write(1, bytes(range(256)))']
        with mock.patch.object(runner.sys, 'stdout', console):
            result = runner.run_logged_process(command, self.base, dict(os.environ), self.log)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), bytes(range(256)))
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), self.log.read_bytes())

    def test_cancellation_during_short_write_flushes_the_pending_chunk(self):
        for signum in [signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT]:
            with self.subTest(signal=signum):
                class InterruptedWriter(io.BytesIO):
                    sent = False

                    def write(self, value):
                        if not self.sent:
                            self.sent = True
                            os.kill(os.getpid(), signum)
                        return super().write(value[:3])
                output = InterruptedWriter()
                log = self.base / ('cancel-' + str(signum) + '.log')
                command = [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '-c',
                           'import os,time; os.write(1, bytes(range(256))); time.sleep(30)']
                with mock.patch.object(runner.sys, 'stdout', mock.Mock(buffer=output)):
                    with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as stopped:
                        runner.run_logged_process(command, self.base, dict(os.environ), log)
                self.assertEqual(stopped.exception.code, 128 + signum)
                self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), bytes(range(256)))
                self.assertEqual(output.getvalue(), log.read_bytes())

    def test_killed_child_with_inherited_writer_cannot_hold_tee_open(self):
        # The grandchild inherits stdout/stderr and ignores TERM. A pipe tee
        # would wait forever after the direct child dies unless it cleans up.
        grandchild = ('import signal,time\n'
                      'signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)\n'
                      'print("INHERITED-WRITER", flush=True)\ntime.sleep(30)')
        child = ('import os,signal,subprocess,sys,time\n'
                 'print("CHILD_PID=" + str(os.getpid()), flush=True)\n'
                 'subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-u","-c",' + repr(grandchild) + '])\ntime.sleep(30)')
        process = self.start_wrapper(child)
        early = read_until(process, b'INHERITED-WRITER\n')
        pid = int(re.search(rb'CHILD_PID=(\d+)', early).group(1))
        os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
        tail, _ = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 0, early + tail)
        self.assertEqual(early + tail, self.log.read_bytes() + b'CHILD_RETURN_CODE=-9\n')

    def test_parent_timeout_term_reaps_child_and_relays_shutdown_output(self):
        child = ('import os,signal,time\n'
                 'def stop(signum, frame):\n'
                 ' print("SHUTDOWN", flush=True)\n raise SystemExit(0)\n'
                 'signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)\n'
                 'print("CHILD_PID=" + str(os.getpid()), flush=True)\ntime.sleep(30)')
        process = self.start_wrapper(child)
        early = read_until(process, b'CHILD_PID=')
        # The marker is deliberately a complete short print in the fixture.
        while b'\n' not in early:
            early += read_until(process, b'\n')
        pid = int(re.search(rb'CHILD_PID=(\d+)', early).group(1))
        with self.assertRaises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            process.wait(timeout=.05)
        process.terminate()
        tail, _ = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 128 + signal.SIGTERM, early + tail)
        self.assertEqual(early + tail, self.log.read_bytes())
        self.assertIn(b'SHUTDOWN\n', early + tail)
        with self.assertRaises(ProcessLookupError):
            os.kill(pid, 0)

    def test_parent_term_escalates_for_child_ignoring_term(self):
        child = ('import os,signal,time\n'
                 'signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN)\n'
                 'print("CHILD_PID=" + str(os.getpid()), flush=True)\ntime.sleep(30)')
        process = self.start_wrapper(child)
        early = read_until(process, b'\n')
        pid = int(re.search(rb'CHILD_PID=(\d+)', early).group(1))
        started = time.monotonic()
        process.terminate()
        time.sleep(.05)
        process.terminate()  # Repeated cancellation must not interrupt cleanup.
        tail, _ = process.communicate(timeout=10)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - started, 10)
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 128 + signal.SIGTERM, early + tail)
        self.assertEqual(early + tail, self.log.read_bytes())
        with self.assertRaises(ProcessLookupError):
            os.kill(pid, 0)

    def test_startup_cancellation_owns_child_inside_popen_and_at_handoff(self):
        for boundary in ['inside_popen', 'returned_handle']:
            for signum in [signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT]:
                with self.subTest(boundary=boundary, signal=signum):
                    captured = []
                    handlers = {value: signal.getsignal(value) for value in [signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT]}
                    mask = signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK, [])

                    def cleanup(processes=captured):
                        for process in processes:
                            if process.poll() is None:
                                os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                            process.wait(timeout=5)
                    self.addCleanup(cleanup)

                    def trace(frame, event, arg):
                        process = None
                        if (boundary == 'inside_popen' and event == 'return'
                                and frame.f_code is subprocess.Popen._execute_child.__code__):
                            process = frame.f_locals['self']
                        elif (boundary == 'returned_handle' and event == 'line'
                              and frame.f_code is runner.run_logged_process.__code__):
                            process = frame.f_locals.get('process')
                        if process is not None:
                            captured.append(process)
                            sys.settrace(None)
                            os.kill(os.getpid(), signum)
                            # Refresh CPython's tracing locals snapshot after
                            # the handler changes a closure cell; do not write
                            # its pre-signal value back when this trace returns.
                            frame.f_locals
                        return trace

                    command = [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '-c', 'import time; time.sleep(60)']
                    log = self.base / (boundary + '-' + str(signum) + '.log')
                    try:
                        sys.settrace(trace)
                        with self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as stopped:
                            runner.run_logged_process(command, self.base, dict(os.environ), log)
                    finally:
                        sys.settrace(None)
                    self.assertEqual(stopped.exception.code, 128 + signum)
                    self.assertEqual(len(captured), 1)
                    self.assertIsNotNone(captured[0].poll())
                    with self.assertRaises(ProcessLookupError):
                        os.kill(captured[0].pid, 0)
                    self.assertEqual(signal.pthread_sigmask(signal.SIG_BLOCK, []), mask)
                    self.assertEqual({value: signal.getsignal(value) for value in handlers}, handlers)

        raise ValueError('Incomplete or malformed combined admission input') from error


def _combined_profile_contract_checked(data, root=ROOT):
    """Exact combined current -> reviewed profile R2 contract, never current admission."""
    root = Path(root)
    runner = (root / 'tools/run138_editor_readiness.py').read_bytes()
    pins = re.findall(rb"^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", runner, re.MULTILINE)
    if len(pins) != 1 or digest(data) != pins[0].decode('ascii'):
        raise ValueError('Unknown complete current combined contract')
    # Runner changes only its pin; unrelated code changes cannot grant admission.
    old_runner = runner.replace(pins[0], ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256.encode(), 1)
    if digest(old_runner) != 'cafa9858b24a18f3827ce5678701b1e32cf533e66d51dc43788b15a74d60a79f':
        raise ValueError('Changed combined readiness runner')
    contract = json.loads(data)
    if (json.dumps(contract, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode() != data:
        raise ValueError('Noncanonical combined contract bytes')
    support = contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    module = (root / COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH).read_bytes()
    slot = rb"^COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '[0-9a-f]{64}'$"
    slots = re.findall(rb"^COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", module, re.MULTILINE)
    if len(slots) != 1 or slots[0].decode('ascii') != COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT:
        raise ValueError('Changed combined admission identity slot')
    fingerprint = re.sub(slot, b"COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '<SELF>'", module, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if digest(fingerprint) != COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT or digest(module) != support[COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH]:
        raise ValueError('Changed combined admission source')
    for name, expected in COMBINED_RAW_SHA256.items():
        if digest((root/name).read_bytes()) != expected:
            raise ValueError('Changed combined raw input: ' + name)
        if name in support and support[name] != expected:
            raise ValueError('Changed combined support binding: ' + name)
    contract = _crop_static_contract(contract, root)
    contract = _static_observability_contract(contract, root)
    contract = _compile_repair_combined_contract(contract, root)
    support = contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    row = contract['feature_batch_sources'][MERCHANT_SOURCE_PATH]
    if row['after_sha256'] != COMBINED_RAW_SHA256[MERCHANT_SOURCE_PATH] or row['hunks'][-1] != MERCHANT_TAG_HUNK:
        raise ValueError('Unknown combined merchant inverse')
    value = (root / MERCHANT_SOURCE_PATH).read_bytes()
    after = MERCHANT_TAG_HUNK['after'].encode(); before = MERCHANT_TAG_HUNK['before'].encode()
    if value.count(after) != 1 or digest(value.replace(after,before,1)) != MERCHANT_PREIMAGE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Merchant source predecessor not restored exactly')
    row['hunks'].pop()
    row['after_sha256'] = MERCHANT_PREIMAGE_SHA256
    support.update(MERCHANT_SUPPORT_PREIMAGES)
    support[COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH] = PROFILE_R2_ADMISSION_SHA256
    restored = (json.dumps(contract, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
    if digest(restored) != PROFILE_R2_CONTRACT_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Complete reviewed profile R2 contract not restored')
    return restored

def historical_readiness_contract(data, root=ROOT):
    """Historical line reader only; the current central gate still rejects old bytes."""
    if digest(data) == ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256:
        return data
    data = _combined_profile_contract(data, root)
    contract = json.loads(data)
    row = contract['feature_batch_sources'][raw.CORE]
    if len(row['hunks']) != 9 or row['after_sha256'] != raw.CURRENT_COORDINATOR_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Not the bounded read-error contract increment')
    value = (Path(root)/raw.CORE).read_text()
    for hunk in reversed(row['hunks'][5:]):
        if value.count(hunk['after']) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Missing or repeated read-error inverse span')
        value = value.replace(hunk['after'], hunk['before'], 1)
    if digest(value.encode()) != raw.OLD_COORDINATOR_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Original profile source not restored')
    row['after_sha256'] = raw.OLD_COORDINATOR_SHA256
    row['hunks'] = row['hunks'][:5]
    support = contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    support['Tests/ContractChecks/test_profile_avatar.py'] = '3be8c14b0d722350f6dde13542824f334e3a3bf66e3e4c687a536deeb51e81f0'
    support['Tests/ContractChecks/test_profile_reload_discard.py'] = '3da1b513c2fdcbafcfe98c6ddc9172cc453caca11954d140c51ed78c2f41da25'
    for path in ['tools/check_profile_read_failure_contract.py', 'Tests/ContractChecks/test_profile_read_failure_remote_admission.py', raw.TESTS, SCANNER_PATH]:
        del support[path]
    original = (json.dumps(contract, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
    if digest(original) != ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Complete original readiness contract not restored')
    return original

def _merchant_business_compile_contract(contract, root=ROOT):
    root=Path(root)
    encoded=(json.dumps(contract,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
    if encoded!=(root/READINESS_PATH).read_bytes():raise ValueError('Unknown current merchant compile contract bytes')
    runner=(root/'tools/run138_editor_readiness.py').read_bytes()
    pins=re.findall(rb"^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$",runner,re.MULTILINE)
    if len(pins)!=1 or pins[0].decode()!=digest(encoded):raise ValueError('Changed merchant compile current pin')
    if digest(runner.replace(pins[0],ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256.encode(),1))!='cafa9858b24a18f3827ce5678701b1e32cf533e66d51dc43788b15a74d60a79f':raise ValueError('Changed merchant compile runner')
    module=(root/COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH).read_bytes()
    slot=rb"^COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '[0-9a-f]{64}'$"
    normalized=re.sub(slot,b"COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '<SELF>'",module,flags=re.MULTILINE)
    support=contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    if digest(normalized)!=COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT or support.get(COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH)!=digest(module):raise ValueError('Changed merchant compile admission')
    for name,expected in MERCHANT_BUSINESS_CURRENT_RAW_SHA256.items():
        if digest((root/name).read_bytes())!=expected:raise ValueError('Changed or mixed merchant compile group: '+name)
    reader=(root/MERCHANT_BUSINESS_READER_PATH).read_bytes()
    for after,before in MERCHANT_BUSINESS_READER_INVERSE_HUNKS:
        if reader.count(after.encode())!=1:raise ValueError('Unknown merchant historical reader adaptation')
        reader=reader.replace(after.encode(),before.encode(),1)
    if digest(reader)!=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_READER_PRE_SHA256:raise ValueError('Complete old merchant reader not restored')
    if support.get(MERCHANT_BUSINESS_READER_PATH)!=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_CURRENT_RAW_SHA256[MERCHANT_BUSINESS_READER_PATH]:raise ValueError('Changed merchant reader support')
    support[MERCHANT_BUSINESS_READER_PATH]=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_READER_PRE_SHA256
    row=contract['feature_batch_sources'][MERCHANT_BUSINESS_COMPILE_PATH]
    if row['after_sha256']!=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_POST_SOURCE_SHA256 or row['hunks'][-1]!=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_COMPILE_HUNK:raise ValueError('Unknown merchant compiler inverse')
    value=(root/MERCHANT_BUSINESS_COMPILE_PATH).read_bytes()
    after=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_COMPILE_HUNK['after'].encode();before=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_COMPILE_HUNK['before'].encode()
    if value.count(after)!=1 or digest(value.replace(after,before,1))!=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_PRE_SOURCE_SHA256:raise ValueError('Merchant compiler predecessor not restored')
    row['hunks'].pop();row['after_sha256']=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_PRE_SOURCE_SHA256
    support[COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH]=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_PRE_ADMISSION_SHA256
    restored=(json.dumps(contract,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
    if digest(restored)!=MERCHANT_BUSINESS_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256:raise ValueError('Complete creator13 floor not restored')
    return contract


def _creator_state_contract(contract, root=ROOT):
    # The current full contract, runner and admission module are authenticated by
    # the caller before entering this historical-only layer. Never scan this view.
    root = Path(root)
    for name, expected in CREATOR_STATE_RAW_SHA256.items():
        if digest((root/name).read_bytes()) != expected:
            raise ValueError('Changed or mixed creator state input: ' + name)
    support = contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    if support.get(CREATOR_STATE_CATALOG) != CREATOR_STATE_RAW_SHA256[CREATOR_STATE_CATALOG]:
        raise ValueError('Unknown creator catalog support binding')
    value = (root/CREATOR_STATE_CATALOG).read_bytes()
    first = b'    "templateShelfState.market.feedback": {'
    last = b'    "templateStory.derivedSummary": {'
    if value.count(first) != 1 or value.count(last) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Missing or repeated creator catalog insertion boundary')
    start = value.index(first); end = value.index(last, start)
    block = value[start:end]
    if len(block) != 5730 or digest(block) != CREATOR_STATE_BLOCK_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Unreviewed creator catalog insertion')
    if digest(value[:start]+value[end:]) != CREATOR_STATE_OLD_CATALOG_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Creator catalog predecessor not restored exactly')
    support[CREATOR_STATE_CATALOG] = CREATOR_STATE_OLD_CATALOG_SHA256
    support[COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH] = CREATOR_STATE_PREADMISSION_SHA256
    restored = (json.dumps(contract, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
    if digest(restored) != CREATOR_STATE_PRECONTRACT_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Complete reviewed fixed45 R3 contract not restored')
    return contract


def _combined_profile_contract(data, root=ROOT):
    try:
        return _combined_profile_contract_checked(data, root)
    except (OSError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, UnicodeError) as error:
        raise ValueError('Incomplete or malformed combined admission input') from error


def _combined_profile_contract_checked(data, root=ROOT):
    """Exact combined current -> reviewed profile R2 contract, never current admission."""
    root = Path(root)
    runner = (root / 'tools/run138_editor_readiness.py').read_bytes()
    pins = re.findall(rb"^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", runner, re.MULTILINE)
    if len(pins) != 1 or digest(data) != pins[0].decode('ascii'):
        raise ValueError('Unknown complete current combined contract')
    # Runner changes only its pin; unrelated code changes cannot grant admission.
    old_runner = runner.replace(pins[0], ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256.encode(), 1)
    if digest(old_runner) != 'cafa9858b24a18f3827ce5678701b1e32cf533e66d51dc43788b15a74d60a79f':
        raise ValueError('Changed combined readiness runner')
    contract = json.loads(data)
    if (json.dumps(contract, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode() != data:
        raise ValueError('Noncanonical combined contract bytes')
    support = contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    module = (root / COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH).read_bytes()
    slot = rb"^COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '[0-9a-f]{64}'$"
    slots = re.findall(rb"^COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", module, re.MULTILINE)
    if len(slots) != 1 or slots[0].decode('ascii') != COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT:
        raise ValueError('Changed combined admission identity slot')
    fingerprint = re.sub(slot, b"COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '<SELF>'", module, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if digest(fingerprint) != COMBINED_ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT or digest(module) != support[COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH]:
        raise ValueError('Changed combined admission source')
    for name, expected in COMBINED_RAW_SHA256.items():
        if digest((root/name).read_bytes()) != expected:
            raise ValueError('Changed combined raw input: ' + name)
        if name in support and support[name] != expected:
            raise ValueError('Changed combined support binding: ' + name)
    contract = _merchant_business_compile_contract(contract, root)
    contract = _creator_state_contract(contract, root)
    contract = _crop_static_contract(contract, root)
    contract = _static_observability_contract(contract, root)
    contract = _compile_repair_combined_contract(contract, root)
    support = contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    row = contract['feature_batch_sources'][MERCHANT_SOURCE_PATH]
    if row['after_sha256'] != COMBINED_RAW_SHA256[MERCHANT_SOURCE_PATH] or row['hunks'][-1] != MERCHANT_TAG_HUNK:
        raise ValueError('Unknown combined merchant inverse')
    value = (root / MERCHANT_SOURCE_PATH).read_bytes()
    after = MERCHANT_TAG_HUNK['after'].encode(); before = MERCHANT_TAG_HUNK['before'].encode()
    if value.count(after) != 1 or digest(value.replace(after,before,1)) != MERCHANT_PREIMAGE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Merchant source predecessor not restored exactly')
    row['hunks'].pop()
    row['after_sha256'] = MERCHANT_PREIMAGE_SHA256
    support.update(MERCHANT_SUPPORT_PREIMAGES)
    support[COMBINED_ADMISSION_PATH] = PROFILE_R2_ADMISSION_SHA256
    restored = (json.dumps(contract, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
    if digest(restored) != PROFILE_R2_CONTRACT_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Complete reviewed profile R2 contract not restored')
    return restored

def historical_readiness_contract(data, root=ROOT):
    """Historical line reader only; the current central gate still rejects old bytes."""
    if digest(data) == ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256:
        return data
    data = _combined_profile_contract(data, root)
    contract = json.loads(data)
    row = contract['feature_batch_sources'][raw.CORE]
    if len(row['hunks']) != 9 or row['after_sha256'] != raw.CURRENT_COORDINATOR_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Not the bounded read-error contract increment')
    value = (Path(root)/raw.CORE).read_text()
    for hunk in reversed(row['hunks'][5:]):
        if value.count(hunk['after']) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Missing or repeated read-error inverse span')
        value = value.replace(hunk['after'], hunk['before'], 1)
    if digest(value.encode()) != raw.OLD_COORDINATOR_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Original profile source not restored')
    row['after_sha256'] = raw.OLD_COORDINATOR_SHA256
    row['hunks'] = row['hunks'][:5]
    support = contract['feature_batch_support_sha256']
    support['Tests/ContractChecks/test_profile_avatar.py'] = '3be8c14b0d722350f6dde13542824f334e3a3bf66e3e4c687a536deeb51e81f0'
    support['Tests/ContractChecks/test_profile_reload_discard.py'] = '3da1b513c2fdcbafcfe98c6ddc9172cc453caca11954d140c51ed78c2f41da25'
    for path in ['tools/check_profile_read_failure_contract.py', 'Tests/ContractChecks/test_profile_read_failure_remote_admission.py', raw.TESTS, SCANNER_PATH]:
        del support[path]
    original = (json.dumps(contract, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n').encode()
    if digest(original) != ORIGINAL_READINESS_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Complete original readiness contract not restored')
    return original

def _native_category_preimage(raw):
    marker = b'\n# Exact c2af navigation compile predecessor layer.\n'
    suffix = b"\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    unittest.main()\n"
    require(raw.count(marker) == 1 and raw.endswith(suffix), 'Unknown native layer source boundary')
    prefix, _ = raw.split(marker, 1)
    for hunk in reversed(NATIVE_CATEGORY_PREFIX_HUNKS):
        after, before = hunk['after'].encode(), hunk['before'].encode()
        require(prefix.count(after) == 1, 'Missing/repeated native source interface span')
        prefix = prefix.replace(after, before, 1)
    slot = b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
    require(prefix.count(slot) == 1, 'Unknown native admission fingerprint slot')
    old = prefix.replace(slot, b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + NATIVE_PRE_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'", 1) + suffix
    require(digest(old) == NATIVE_PRE_SHA256[SELF_PATH], 'Complete c2af admission source not restored')
    return old


def native_current_readiness_source(raw):
    """Current admission requires the entire reviewed member-copy implementation."""
    pins = re.findall(rb"(?m)^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", raw)
    if len(pins) != 1 or digest(raw.replace(pins[0], NATIVE_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256.encode(), 1)) != NATIVE_READINESS_AFTER_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Changed complete current readiness member-copy source')
    return raw


def native_readiness_source(raw):
    """Remove only the exact member-copy optimization, retaining the live pin."""
    pins = re.findall(rb"(?m)^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", raw)
    if len(pins) != 1:
        raise ValueError('Unknown native readiness contract pin')
    normalized = raw.replace(pins[0], NATIVE_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256.encode(), 1)
    if digest(normalized) == NATIVE_PRE_SHA256[RUNNER_PATH]:
        return raw  # The explicit c2af predecessor has no member-copy extension.
    for hunk in reversed(NATIVE_READINESS_HUNKS):
        after, before = hunk['after'].encode(), hunk['before'].encode()
        if raw.count(after) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Unknown exact readiness member-copy source span')
        raw = raw.replace(after, before, 1)
    if digest(raw.replace(pins[0], NATIVE_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256.encode(), 1)) != NATIVE_PRE_SHA256[RUNNER_PATH]:
        raise ValueError('Complete c2af readiness member-copy predecessor not restored')
    return raw


def native_predecessor_source(path, raw):
    """Exact historical bytes only; current admission remains checked_current."""
    if path not in NATIVE_PRE_SHA256:
        return raw
    if digest(raw) == NATIVE_PRE_SHA256[path]:
        return raw
    if path == NATIVE_LEAF_PATHS[0]:
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, NATIVE_NAV_ROW, path)
    elif path == 'Questify.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj':
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, NATIVE_PBX_REPAIR_ROW, path)
    elif path == 'tools/club_customer_directory_admission.py':
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, NATIVE_HELPER_ROW, path)
    elif path == NATIVE_PROJECTION_PATH:
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, NATIVE_PROJECTION_ROW, path)
    elif path == SELF_PATH:
        old = _native_category_preimage(raw)
    elif path == PROFILE_PATH:
        slot = b"DISCOVERY_HELPER_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
        require(raw.count(slot) == 1, 'Unknown native profile source pin')
        old = raw.replace(slot, b"DISCOVERY_HELPER_FINGERPRINT = '" + NATIVE_PRE_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'", 1)
    elif path == RUNNER_PATH:
        raw = native_readiness_source(raw)
        pins = re.findall(rb"(?m)^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", raw)
        require(len(pins) == 1, 'Unknown native readiness pin')
        old = raw.replace(pins[0], NATIVE_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256.encode(), 1)
    elif path == CATEGORY_GATE:
        import base64, zlib
        normalized, source = _decoded_external_template(raw)
        require(source == (ROOT / SELF_PATH).read_bytes(), 'Unknown native complete external template')
        old_source = _native_category_preimage(source)
        encoded = base64.b85encode(zlib.compress(old_source, 9)).decode()
        first = b'\n# CATEGORY_ROAM_FROZEN_SOURCE_BEGIN\n'
        last = b'# CATEGORY_ROAM_FROZEN_SOURCE_END\n'
        suffix = b"\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    unittest.main()\n"
        old = normalized[:-len(suffix)] + first + b'FROZEN_REGISTRATION_SOURCE_ZLIB_BASE85 = (\n' + b''.join(
            ('    ' + repr(encoded[i:i+80]) + '\n').encode() for i in range(0, len(encoded), 80)) + b')\n' + last + suffix
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Unreviewed native predecessor path')
    require(digest(old) == NATIVE_PRE_SHA256[path], 'Complete c2af source not restored: ' + path)
    return old


def native_predecessor_contract(value):
    """Authenticate new bytes, then restore the entire published c2af contract."""
    value = copy.deepcopy(value)
    if digest(encode(value)) == NATIVE_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256:
        return value  # Explicit historical-only value, never current admission.
    path = NATIVE_LEAF_PATHS[0]
    require(value['feature_batch_sources'].get(path) == NATIVE_NAV_ROW, 'Unknown native UUID-only source row')
    require(digest((ROOT / path).read_bytes()) == NATIVE_NAV_ROW['after_sha256'], 'Native current Navigation bytes changed')
    require(digest((ROOT / 'tools/club_customer_directory_admission.py').read_bytes()) == NATIVE_HELPER_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Native current club fixture input changed')
    require(value['entry_projection_module_sha256'] == NATIVE_PROJECTION_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Unknown exact current member-copy projection pin')
    projection = (ROOT / NATIVE_PROJECTION_PATH).read_bytes()
    require(digest(projection) == NATIVE_PROJECTION_ROW['after_sha256'], 'Changed actual member-copy projection bytes')
    require(digest(native_predecessor_source(NATIVE_PROJECTION_PATH, projection)) == NATIVE_PROJECTION_ROW['before_sha256'],
            'Complete c2af projection source not restored')
    value['entry_projection_module_sha256'] = NATIVE_PROJECTION_ROW['before_sha256']
    pbx = 'Questify.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj'
    row = value['feature_batch_sources'][pbx]
    hunks = NATIVE_PBX_REPAIR_ROW['hunks']
    require(digest((ROOT / pbx).read_bytes()) == NATIVE_PBX_REPAIR_ROW['after_sha256'], 'Native canonical PBX bytes changed')
    require(row['after_sha256'] == NATIVE_PBX_REPAIR_ROW['after_sha256'] and row['hunks'][-len(hunks):] == hunks,
            'Unknown canonical PBX inverse extension')
    row['after_sha256'] = NATIVE_PBX_REPAIR_ROW['before_sha256']
    del row['hunks'][-len(hunks):]
    require(digest(encode(row)) == NATIVE_PRE_PBX_ROW_SHA256, 'Complete original209 PBX row not restored')
    for path, expected in NATIVE_PRE_SUPPORT.items():
        raw = (ROOT / path).read_bytes()
        require(value['feature_batch_support_sha256'].get(path) == digest(raw), 'Native current support changed: ' + path)
        require(digest(native_predecessor_source(path, raw)) == expected, 'Unknown native predecessor support: ' + path)
        value['feature_batch_support_sha256'][path] = expected
    del value['feature_batch_sources'][NATIVE_LEAF_PATHS[0]]
    require(digest(encode(value)) == NATIVE_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256, 'Complete published c2af contract not restored')
    return value


def native_predecessor_fixture_source(path, raw, current_contract):
    """Construct explicit c2af49 fixture bytes; never backfill a current root."""
    if path == CONTRACT_PATH:
        require(raw == current_contract, 'Mixed native current fixture contract')
        return encode(native_predecessor_contract(json.loads(raw)))
    return native_predecessor_source(path, raw)

    def fixture(self):
        life = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='native-current51-')
        self.addCleanup(life.cleanup)

        self.assertEqual(len(paths), 51)
        for relative in paths:
            file = root / relative; file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            file.write_bytes((R / relative).read_bytes())
        return root, paths

    def test_exact_native_leaf_and_contract_restore_published_c2af(self):
        raw = (R / repair.CONTRACT_PATH).read_bytes()
        before = repair.native_predecessor_contract(json.loads(raw))
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.encode(before)),
                         'd3fedafc9efe917220f4c52cb4c82d742f840a7307546da35e4da130a80d7fdb')
        path = repair.NATIVE_LEAF_PATHS[0]
        self.assertNotIn(path, before['feature_batch_sources'])
        value = (R / path).read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.native_predecessor_source(path, value)),
                         'ff473e0c1695a05f3b983e0675f0e7cd431f5b8258dad01b6d1a73f0911b0a2b')
        self.assertIn(b'nonisolated static func == (lhs: Self, rhs: Self) -> Bool { lhs.id == rhs.id }', value)
        self.assertIn(b'nonisolated func hash(into hasher: inout Hasher) { hasher.combine(id) }', value)

        mutants = [raw + b'\n', raw.replace(b'lhs.id == rhs.id', b'lhs.capture.location == rhs.capture.location'),
                   raw.replace(b'hasher.combine(id)', b'hasher.combine(capture)'),
                   raw.replace(b'let id = UUID()', b'var id = UUID()'), raw.replace(after, b'', 1), raw + after]
        for mutant in mutants:
            with self.subTest(mutant=repair.digest(mutant)), self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                repair.native_predecessor_source(path, mutant)

        for mutant in [raw + b'\n', raw.replace(b'547DD20422C04B364B7AAC62', b'547DD20422C04B364B7AAC63')]:

        for row in repair.NATIVE_PROJECTION_ROW['hunks']:

        for row in repair.NATIVE_READINESS_HUNKS:
            after = row['after'].encode()
            for mutant in (source.replace(after, b'', 1), source + after, source.replace(after, after[:-1] + b'X', 1)):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError): repair.native_readiness_source(mutant)

    def test_actual_projection_old_missing_same_size_mtime_and_coherent_repin_rejected(self):
        path = R / repair.NATIVE_PROJECTION_PATH
        contract = R / repair.CONTRACT_PATH; runner = R / repair.RUNNER_PATH
        saved = {p: (p.read_bytes(), p.stat()) for p in (path, contract, runner)}
        for p, (_, metadata) in saved.items(): self.assertEqual(metadata.st_nlink, 1, str(p))
        raw = saved[contract][0]; source = saved[path][0]
        repair.checked_current(raw, R)
        def restore():
            for p, (data, metadata) in saved.items():
                p.write_bytes(data); os.utime(p, ns=(metadata.st_atime_ns, metadata.st_mtime_ns))
        try:
            for mutant in (repair.native_predecessor_source(repair.NATIVE_PROJECTION_PATH, source),
                           bytes([source[0] ^ 1]) + source[1:]):
                path.write_bytes(mutant); os.utime(path, ns=(saved[path][1].st_atime_ns, saved[path][1].st_mtime_ns))
                with self.assertRaises((AssertionError, ValueError)): repair.checked_current(raw, R)
            restore(); path.unlink()
            with self.assertRaises((AssertionError, ValueError, OSError)): repair.checked_current(raw, R)
            restore()
            mutant = bytes([source[0] ^ 1]) + source[1:]
            value = json.loads(raw); value['entry_projection_module_sha256'] = repair.digest(mutant)
            changed = repair.encode(value)
            path.write_bytes(mutant); contract.write_bytes(changed)
            runner.write_bytes(saved[runner][0].replace(repair.digest(raw).encode(), repair.digest(changed).encode(), 1))
            with self.assertRaises((AssertionError, ValueError)): repair.checked_current(changed, R)
        finally:

def _description_category_preimage(raw):
    marker = b'\n# Exact 7b node-description initialization predecessor layer.\n'
    suffix = b"\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    unittest.main()\n"
    require(digest(raw) == IMPLEMENTATION_SHA256, 'Changed complete description admission source')
    require(raw.count(marker) == 1 and raw.endswith(suffix), 'Unknown description layer source boundary')
    prefix, _ = raw.split(marker, 1)
    for hunk in reversed(DESCRIPTION_CATEGORY_PREFIX_HUNKS):
        after, before = hunk['after'].encode(), hunk['before'].encode()
        require(prefix.count(after) == 1, 'Missing/repeated description source interface span')
        prefix = prefix.replace(after, before, 1)
    slot = b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
    require(prefix.count(slot) == 1, 'Unknown description admission fingerprint slot')
    old = prefix.replace(slot, b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + DESCRIPTION_PRE_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'", 1) + suffix
    require(digest(old) == DESCRIPTION_PRE_SHA256[SELF_PATH], 'Complete published 7b admission source not restored')
    return old


def description_predecessor_source(path, raw):
    """Exact complete published 7b bytes; never a current-input admission bypass."""
    if path not in DESCRIPTION_PRE_SHA256:
        return raw
    if digest(raw) == DESCRIPTION_PRE_SHA256[path]:
        return raw  # Explicit historical-only interface; current checks require new bytes.
    if path == DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH:
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, DESCRIPTION_LEAF_ROW, path)
    elif path == DESCRIPTION_HELPER_PATH:
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, DESCRIPTION_HELPER_ROW, path)
    elif path == SELF_PATH:
        old = _description_category_preimage(raw)
    elif path == PROFILE_PATH:
        slot = b"DISCOVERY_HELPER_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
        require(raw.count(slot) == 1, 'Unknown description profile source pin')
        old = raw.replace(slot, b"DISCOVERY_HELPER_FINGERPRINT = '" + DESCRIPTION_PRE_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'", 1)
    elif path == RUNNER_PATH:
        native_current_readiness_source(raw)
        pins = re.findall(rb"(?m)^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", raw)
        require(len(pins) == 1, 'Unknown description readiness pin')
        old = raw.replace(pins[0], DESCRIPTION_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256.encode(), 1)
    elif path == CATEGORY_GATE:
        import base64, zlib
        normalized, source = _decoded_external_template(raw)
        require(source == (ROOT / SELF_PATH).read_bytes(), 'Unknown description complete external template')
        old_source = _description_category_preimage(source)
        encoded = base64.b85encode(zlib.compress(old_source, 9)).decode()
        first = b'\n# CATEGORY_ROAM_FROZEN_SOURCE_BEGIN\n'
        last = b'# CATEGORY_ROAM_FROZEN_SOURCE_END\n'
        suffix = b"\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    unittest.main()\n"
        old = normalized[:-len(suffix)] + first + b'FROZEN_REGISTRATION_SOURCE_ZLIB_BASE85 = (\n' + b''.join(
            ('    ' + repr(encoded[i:i+80]) + '\n').encode() for i in range(0, len(encoded), 80)) + b')\n' + last + suffix
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Unreviewed description predecessor path')
    require(digest(old) == DESCRIPTION_PRE_SHA256[path], 'Complete published 7b source not restored: ' + path)
    return old


def description_current_inputs(value, root=ROOT):
    """Re-read every actual new boundary member before any old value or cache."""
    root = Path(root)
    require(not root.is_symlink(), 'Description current root is a symlink')
    contents = {}
    for path in DESCRIPTION_PRE_SHA256:
        file = root / path
        require(not file.is_symlink() and file.is_file() and file.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()),
                'Missing, escaped or symlinked description current input: ' + path)
        contents[path] = file.read_bytes()
    raw = (root / CONTRACT_PATH).read_bytes()
    require(encode(value) == raw, 'Changed or mixed actual description contract')
    runner = contents[RUNNER_PATH]
    native_current_readiness_source(runner)
    pins = re.findall(rb"(?m)^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", runner)
    require(len(pins) == 1 and pins[0].decode() == digest(raw), 'Unknown complete description contract pin')
    module = contents[SELF_PATH]
    require(digest(module) == IMPLEMENTATION_SHA256, 'Loaded description admission differs from current bytes')
    validate_external_source_template(root, module)
    slot = b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
    require(module.count(slot) == 1 and digest(module.replace(slot, b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '<SELF>'", 1)) == ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT,
            'Changed complete description admission fingerprint')
    require(value['feature_batch_sources'].get(DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH) == DESCRIPTION_LEAF_ROW,
            'Unknown exact description initialization inverse')
    require(digest(contents[DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH]) == DESCRIPTION_LEAF_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Old or changed current description initializer')
    require(digest(contents[DESCRIPTION_HELPER_PATH]) == DESCRIPTION_HELPER_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Old or changed current description fixture producer')
    for path, expected in DESCRIPTION_PRE_SUPPORT.items():
        require(value['feature_batch_support_sha256'].get(path) == digest(contents[path]),
                'Changed current description support: ' + path)
        require(digest(description_predecessor_source(path, contents[path])) == expected,
                'Unknown complete description support predecessor: ' + path)
    require(digest(description_predecessor_source(RUNNER_PATH, runner)) == DESCRIPTION_PRE_SHA256[RUNNER_PATH],
            'Changed complete description readiness implementation')
    return contents


def description_predecessor_contract(value, root=ROOT):
    """Admit actual new bytes, then restore the entire immutable 7b contract."""
    value = copy.deepcopy(value)
    if digest(encode(value)) == DESCRIPTION_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256:
        return value  # Exact historical-only contract; checked_current never accepts it as current.

        return encode(description_predecessor_contract(json.loads(raw)))

class DescriptionInitializationCompileAdmissionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """New current52 is admitted before exact published51/49/47 history."""

    def raw(self):
        return (R / repair.CONTRACT_PATH).read_bytes()

    def fixture(self):
        life = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='description-current52-')
        self.addCleanup(life.cleanup)
        root = Path(life.name)
        paths = set(repair.PROFILE_CONTEXT_INPUTS) | set(repair.REPAIR_LEAF_PATHS) | set(repair.NATIVE_CURRENT_INPUTS) | {repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH}
        self.assertEqual(len(paths), 52)
        for path in paths:
            file = root / path; file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            file.write_bytes((R / path).read_bytes())
        return root, paths

    def test_exact_one_hunk_reads_description_once_without_published_self_access(self):
        path = repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH; source = (R / path).read_bytes()
        row = repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_ROW
        self.assertEqual(row['before_sha256'], '663f5aa34981ca0e3ec9207e165140b78bb8c8a3858314bf2cda4d836599f2e3')
        self.assertEqual(row['after_sha256'], 'c03d2b762a9c339449f799214b356180ead19d9c6bc9065ff2c25e0cabc77053')
        self.assertEqual(len(row['hunks']), 1)
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(source), row['after_sha256'])
        old = repair.description_predecessor_source(path, source)
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(old), row['before_sha256'])
        self.assertEqual(source, old.replace(row['hunks'][0]['before'].encode(), row['hunks'][0]['after'].encode(), 1))
        body = source.split(b'    init(source: ProjectEditNodeDescriptionSource) {', 1)[1].split(b'    }', 1)[0]
        self.assertEqual(body.count(b'source.node.wrappedValue.description'), 1)
        self.assertIn(b'text = initialText; acknowledgedBytes = Data(initialText.utf8)', body)
        self.assertNotIn(b'Data(text.utf8)', body)

    def test_complete_new_contract_restores_7b_then_unchanged_native_and_repair_floors(self):
        value = json.loads(self.raw())
        old = repair.description_predecessor_contract(value)
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.encode(old)), '9c26993734c6ba8d4623165187cb0cfcebc1ff20e3c9209da7a2982099ee2cb6')
        self.assertNotIn(repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH, old['feature_batch_sources'])
        self.assertEqual(value['node_description_sources'], old['node_description_sources'])
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.encode(repair.native_predecessor_contract(value))), 'd3fedafc9efe917220f4c52cb4c82d742f840a7307546da35e4da130a80d7fdb')
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.encode(repair.repair_predecessor_contract(value))), 'b72d9b1024daadb5273a4de24c0175d42c04516b1f89c6c53c0f9c40dd7a77b6')
        for path, expected in repair.DESCRIPTION_PRE_SHA256.items():
            source = (R / path).read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.description_predecessor_source(path, source)), expected)
            for mutant in (source + b'\n', source.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'), bytes([source[0] ^ 1]) + source[1:]):
                with self.subTest(path=path), self.assertRaises((AssertionError, ValueError)):
                    repair.description_predecessor_source(path, mutant)

    def test_description_inverse_rejects_missing_duplicate_and_edited_hunk(self):
        path = repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH; source = (R / path).read_bytes()
        hunk = repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_ROW['hunks'][0]['after'].encode()
        for mutant in (source.replace(hunk, b'', 1), source + hunk,
                       source.replace(b'Data(initialText.utf8)', b'Data(text.utf8)', 1),
                       source.replace(b'let initialText', b'var initialText', 1)):
            with self.assertRaises(AssertionError): repair.description_predecessor_source(path, mutant)

    def test_old_leaf_and_coherent_leaf_contract_runner_repin_never_admit_as_current(self):
        path = R / repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH; source = path.read_bytes(); raw = self.raw()
        runnerpath = R / repair.RUNNER_PATH; runner = runnerpath.read_bytes()
        for mutant in (repair.description_predecessor_source(repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH, source),
                       bytes([source[0] ^ 1]) + source[1:]):
            value = json.loads(raw)
            value['feature_batch_sources'][repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH]['after_sha256'] = repair.digest(mutant)
            value['feature_batch_support_sha256'][repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH] = repair.digest(mutant)
            changed = repair.encode(value)
            replacements = {path: mutant, R / repair.CONTRACT_PATH: changed,
                            runnerpath: runner.replace(repair.digest(raw).encode(), repair.digest(changed).encode(), 1)}
            original = Path.read_bytes
            with patch.object(Path, 'read_bytes', lambda p: replacements[p] if p in replacements else original(p)):
                with self.assertRaises((AssertionError, ValueError)): repair.checked_current(changed, R)

        root, paths = self.fixture(); raw = self.raw(); original = Path.read_bytes; reads = []
        def read(path):

def _actor_category_preimage(raw):
    marker = b'\n# Exact 42 social ReaderKey actor predecessor layer.\n'
    suffix = b"\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    unittest.main()\n"
    require(digest(raw) == IMPLEMENTATION_SHA256, 'Changed complete actor admission source')
    require(raw.count(marker) == 1 and raw.endswith(suffix), 'Unknown actor layer source boundary')
    prefix, _ = raw.split(marker, 1)
    for hunk in reversed(ACTOR_CATEGORY_PREFIX_HUNKS):
        after, before = hunk['after'].encode(), hunk['before'].encode()
        require(prefix.count(after) == 1, 'Missing/repeated actor source interface span')
        prefix = prefix.replace(after, before, 1)
    slot = b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
    require(prefix.count(slot) == 1, 'Unknown actor admission fingerprint slot')
    old = prefix.replace(slot, b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + ACTOR_PRE_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'", 1) + suffix
    require(digest(old) == ACTOR_PRE_SHA256[SELF_PATH], 'Complete published 42 admission source not restored')
    return old


def actor_predecessor_source(path, raw):
    """Exact complete published 42 bytes; never a current-input admission bypass."""
    if path not in ACTOR_PRE_SHA256:
        return raw
    if digest(raw) == ACTOR_PRE_SHA256[path]:
        return raw  # Explicit historical-only interface; current checks require new bytes.
    if path == ACTOR_LEAF_PATH:
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, ACTOR_LEAF_ROW, path)
    elif path == ACTOR_HELPER_PATH:
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, ACTOR_HELPER_ROW, path)
    elif path == ACTOR_PROJECTION_PATH:
        old = _inverse_exact(raw, ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW, path)
    elif path == SELF_PATH:
        old = _actor_category_preimage(raw)
    elif path == PROFILE_PATH:
        slot = b"DISCOVERY_HELPER_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
        require(raw.count(slot) == 1, 'Unknown actor profile source pin')
        old = raw.replace(slot, b"DISCOVERY_HELPER_FINGERPRINT = '" + ACTOR_PRE_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'", 1)
    elif path == RUNNER_PATH:
        native_current_readiness_source(raw)
        pins = re.findall(rb"(?m)^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", raw)
        require(len(pins) == 1, 'Unknown actor readiness pin')
        old = raw.replace(pins[0], ACTOR_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256.encode(), 1)
    elif path == CATEGORY_GATE:
        import base64, zlib
        normalized, source = _decoded_external_template(raw)
        require(source == (ROOT / SELF_PATH).read_bytes(), 'Unknown actor complete external template')
        old_source = _actor_category_preimage(source)
        encoded = base64.b85encode(zlib.compress(old_source, 9)).decode()
        first = b'\n# CATEGORY_ROAM_FROZEN_SOURCE_BEGIN\n'
        last = b'# CATEGORY_ROAM_FROZEN_SOURCE_END\n'
        suffix = b"\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    unittest.main()\n"
        old = normalized[:-len(suffix)] + first + b'FROZEN_REGISTRATION_SOURCE_ZLIB_BASE85 = (\n' + b''.join(
            ('    ' + repr(encoded[i:i+80]) + '\n').encode() for i in range(0, len(encoded), 80)) + b')\n' + last + suffix
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Unreviewed actor predecessor path')
    require(digest(old) == ACTOR_PRE_SHA256[path], 'Complete published 42 source not restored: ' + path)
    return old


def actor_current_inputs(value, root=ROOT):
    """Re-read all actual actor boundary bytes before any predecessor or cache."""
    root = Path(root)
    require(not root.is_symlink(), 'Actor current root is a symlink')
    contents = {}
    for path in ACTOR_PRE_SHA256:
        file = root / path
        parts = Path(path).parts
        require(all(not (root / Path(*parts[:end])).is_symlink() for end in range(1, len(parts) + 1)),
                'Symlink component in actor current input: ' + path)
        require(not file.is_symlink() and file.is_file() and file.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()),
                'Missing, escaped or symlinked actor current input: ' + path)
        contents[path] = file.read_bytes()
    contract_file = root / CONTRACT_PATH
    require(not contract_file.is_symlink() and contract_file.is_file()
            and contract_file.resolve().is_relative_to(root.resolve()), 'Invalid actual actor contract input')
    raw = contract_file.read_bytes()
    require(encode(value) == raw, 'Changed or mixed actual actor contract')
    runner = contents[RUNNER_PATH]
    native_current_readiness_source(runner)
    pins = re.findall(rb"(?m)^CONTRACT_SHA256 = '([0-9a-f]{64})'$", runner)
    require(len(pins) == 1 and pins[0].decode() == digest(raw), 'Unknown complete actor contract pin')
    module = contents[SELF_PATH]
    require(digest(module) == IMPLEMENTATION_SHA256, 'Loaded actor admission differs from current bytes')
    validate_external_source_template(root, module)
    slot = b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '" + ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT.encode() + b"'"
    require(module.count(slot) == 1 and digest(module.replace(slot, b"ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT = '<SELF>'", 1)) == ADMISSION_FINGERPRINT,
            'Changed complete actor admission fingerprint')
    require(value['feature_batch_sources'].get(ACTOR_LEAF_PATH) == ACTOR_LEAF_ROW,
            'Unknown exact actor initialization inverse')
    require(digest(contents[ACTOR_LEAF_PATH]) == ACTOR_LEAF_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Old or changed current actor initializer')
    require(digest(contents[ACTOR_HELPER_PATH]) == ACTOR_HELPER_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Old or changed current actor fixture producer')
    require(value['entry_projection_module_sha256'] == ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Unknown exact current review projection pin')
    require(digest(contents[ACTOR_PROJECTION_PATH]) == ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Old or changed current review projection source')
    require(digest(actor_predecessor_source(ACTOR_PROJECTION_PATH, contents[ACTOR_PROJECTION_PATH])) == ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW['before_sha256'],
            'Complete published 42 review projection not restored')
    for path, expected in ACTOR_PRE_SUPPORT.items():
        require(value['feature_batch_support_sha256'].get(path) == digest(contents[path]),
                'Changed current actor support: ' + path)
        require(digest(actor_predecessor_source(path, contents[path])) == expected,
                'Unknown complete actor support predecessor: ' + path)
    require(digest(actor_predecessor_source(RUNNER_PATH, runner)) == ACTOR_PRE_SHA256[RUNNER_PATH],
            'Changed complete actor readiness implementation')
    predecessor = copy.deepcopy(value)
    require(predecessor['feature_batch_sources'].pop(ACTOR_LEAF_PATH) == ACTOR_LEAF_ROW,
            'Missing actual actor inverse row')
    for path, expected in ACTOR_PRE_SUPPORT.items():
        predecessor['feature_batch_support_sha256'][path] = expected
    predecessor['entry_projection_module_sha256'] = ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW['before_sha256']
    require(digest(encode(predecessor)) == ACTOR_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256,
            'Actual actor contract does not restore complete published 42 bytes')
    return contents


def actor_predecessor_contract(value, root=ROOT):
    """Admit actual new bytes, then restore the entire immutable 42 contract."""
    value = copy.deepcopy(value)
    if digest(encode(value)) == ACTOR_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256:
        return value  # Exact historical-only contract; checked_current requires current bytes.
    actor_current_inputs(value, root)
    require(value['feature_batch_sources'].pop(ACTOR_LEAF_PATH) == ACTOR_LEAF_ROW,
            'Missing complete actor inverse row')
    for path, expected in ACTOR_PRE_SUPPORT.items():
        value['feature_batch_support_sha256'][path] = expected
    require(value['entry_projection_module_sha256'] == ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW['after_sha256'],
            'Missing exact current review projection pin')
    value['entry_projection_module_sha256'] = ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW['before_sha256']
    require(digest(encode(value)) == ACTOR_PRE_CONTRACT_SHA256,
            'Complete published 42 readiness contract not restored')
    return value


def actor_predecessor_fixture_source(path, raw, current_contract):
    """Build genuine published 42/52 inputs, never fill a missing current53 file."""
    if path == CONTRACT_PATH:
        require(raw == current_contract, 'Mixed actor current fixture contract')
        return encode(actor_predecessor_contract(json.loads(raw)))
    return actor_predecessor_source(path, raw)


def actor_predecessor_fixture_helper(root=ROOT):
    """Expose only six literal fixture inputs from the authenticated 42 helper."""
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    root = Path(root)
    value = json.loads((root / CONTRACT_PATH).read_bytes())
    contents = actor_current_inputs(value, root)
    raw = actor_predecessor_source(ACTOR_HELPER_PATH, contents[ACTOR_HELPER_PATH])
    require(digest(raw) == ACTOR_PRE_SHA256[ACTOR_HELPER_PATH], 'Unknown 42 fixture helper input')
    wanted = {'SOURCE_EDITS', 'ADDED_SUPPORT', 'CONTRACT_PATH', 'EVOLUTION_SOURCES', 'EVOLUTION_SUPPORT', 'FLOOR_INPUTS'}
    values = {}
    for node in ast.parse(raw).body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in wanted:
                require(name not in values, 'Repeated historical fixture helper input: ' + name)
                values[name] = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
    require(set(values) == wanted, 'Incomplete historical fixture helper inputs')
    return SimpleNamespace(**values)

class SocialReaderKeyActorCompileAdmissionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Actual current53 precedes exact published42/52, 7b51, c2af49 and 47."""

    def raw(self):
        return (R / repair.CONTRACT_PATH).read_bytes()

    def fixture(self):
        life = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='actor-current53-')
        self.addCleanup(life.cleanup)
        root = Path(life.name)
        paths = set(repair.PROFILE_CONTEXT_INPUTS) | set(repair.REPAIR_LEAF_PATHS) | set(repair.NATIVE_CURRENT_INPUTS) | {repair.DESCRIPTION_LEAF_PATH, repair.ACTOR_LEAF_PATH}
        self.assertEqual(len(paths), 53)
        for path in paths:
            file = root / path; file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            file.write_bytes((R / path).read_bytes())
        return root, paths

    def test_exact_actor_hunk_changes_only_reader_key_initializer(self):
        path = repair.ACTOR_LEAF_PATH; source = (R / path).read_bytes()
        row = repair.ACTOR_LEAF_ROW
        self.assertEqual(row['before_sha256'], 'f79b53c8f0ab4ecdd4a21c2d23fe6a1c7b1040c50680dd6b6c1093cdcb3f2c5b')
        self.assertEqual(row['after_sha256'], '0e14cc76c72416cf152f8edbd02383251b2671952f958a18af078e883f4ffc51')
        self.assertEqual(row['hunks'], [{'before': '        init(_ reader: any DiscoveryReading) {\n',
                                         'after': '        @MainActor init(_ reader: any DiscoveryReading) {\n'}])
        old = repair.actor_predecessor_source(path, source)
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(old), row['before_sha256'])
        self.assertEqual(source, old.replace(row['hunks'][0]['before'].encode(), row['hunks'][0]['after'].encode(), 1))

    def test_complete_actor_contract_restores_exact_42_and_every_older_floor(self):
        value = json.loads(self.raw()); old = repair.actor_predecessor_contract(value)
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.encode(old)), '6fa7fd18b5000d3843f4c5809d58cd97f0b40dd0b3b41ad933583aa6250522e4')
        self.assertEqual(len(value['feature_batch_sources']), 135)
        self.assertEqual(len(old['feature_batch_sources']), 134)
        self.assertEqual(len(value['feature_batch_support_sha256']), 521)
        self.assertNotIn(repair.ACTOR_LEAF_PATH, old['feature_batch_sources'])
        self.assertEqual(value['node_description_sources'], old['node_description_sources'])
        for reader, expected in [(repair.description_predecessor_contract, '9c26993734c6ba8d4623165187cb0cfcebc1ff20e3c9209da7a2982099ee2cb6'),
                                 (repair.native_predecessor_contract, 'd3fedafc9efe917220f4c52cb4c82d742f840a7307546da35e4da130a80d7fdb'),
                                 (repair.repair_predecessor_contract, 'b72d9b1024daadb5273a4de24c0175d42c04516b1f89c6c53c0f9c40dd7a77b6')]:
            self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.encode(reader(value))), expected)

    def test_complete_actor_source_interfaces_restore_exact_42_bytes(self):
        for path, expected in repair.ACTOR_PRE_SHA256.items():
            source = (R / path).read_bytes()
            self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.actor_predecessor_source(path, source)), expected)
            for mutant in (source + b'\n', source.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'), bytes([source[0] ^ 1]) + source[1:]):
                with self.subTest(path=path), self.assertRaises((AssertionError, ValueError)):
                    repair.actor_predecessor_source(path, mutant)

    def test_review_projection_exact_single_hunk_restores_42_then_native_predecessor(self):
        path = repair.ACTOR_PROJECTION_PATH; source = (R / path).read_bytes()
        row = repair.ACTOR_PROJECTION_ROW
        self.assertEqual(row['before_sha256'], '7e14668c3ab789f3903971a8de30a828c1cac36c6755d67f81e92ef29356c7f1')
        self.assertEqual(row['after_sha256'], '3980907d0a3d33e40f229c6f856ac78024b18498ea7c3f4dcd28d34862f8b280')
        self.assertEqual(len(row['hunks']), 1)
        before = repair.actor_predecessor_source(path, source)
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(before), row['before_sha256'])
        self.assertEqual(source, before.replace(row['hunks'][0]['before'].encode(), row['hunks'][0]['after'].encode(), 1))
        self.assertEqual(repair.digest(repair.native_predecessor_source(path, source)), 'c0e6a5351bd024bdcbf8d1152bb4e8cb683cc5ff15e370627a14e229a1158727')
        value = json.loads(self.raw()); old = repair.actor_predecessor_contract(value)
        self.assertEqual(value['entry_projection_module_sha256'], row['after_sha256'])
        self.assertEqual(old['entry_projection_module_sha256'], row['before_sha256'])

        def restore():
            for p, (data, stamp) in saved.items():
                p.write_bytes(data); os.utime(p, ns=(stamp.st_atime_ns, stamp.st_mtime_ns))
        try:
            for mutant in (repair.actor_predecessor_source(repair.ACTOR_PROJECTION_PATH, source),

    def test_page_disappearance_cleanup_rejects_removal_reorder_duplicate_and_async_gap(self):
        app = self.read('App/MerchantBusinessViews.swift')
        self.assert_page_disappearance_cleanup(app)
        operations = ['draftReturn.retire()', 'editor = nil', 'pendingMutation = nil', 'model.invalidate()']
        line = '        .onDisappear { ' + '; '.join(operations) + ' }'
        self.assertEqual(app.count(line), 1)
        mutations = []
        for index in range(len(operations)):
            mutations.append(('remove_' + str(index), operations[:index] + operations[index + 1:]))
            mutations.append(('duplicate_' + str(index), operations[:index] + [operations[index]] + operations[index:]))
        for index in range(len(operations) - 1):
            reordered = operations.copy()
            reordered[index:index + 2] = reversed(reordered[index:index + 2])
            mutations.append(('reorder_' + str(index), reordered))
            mutations.append(('await_gap_' + str(index), operations[:index + 1] + ['await Task.yield()'] + operations[index + 1:]))
            mutations.append(('task_gap_' + str(index), operations[:index + 1] + ['Task { ' + '; '.join(operations[index + 1:]) + ' }']))
        changed_sources = [(name, app.replace(line, '        .onDisappear { ' + '; '.join(changed) + ' }', 1))
                           for name, changed in mutations]
        changed_sources += [
            ('duplicate_handler', app.replace(line, line + '\n' + line, 1)),
            ('comment_decoy', app.replace(line, '        // ' + line.strip(), 1)),
        ]
        for name, changed in changed_sources:
            with self.subTest(mutation=name):
                self.assertNotEqual(changed, app)
                with self.assertRaises(AssertionError):
                    self.assert_page_disappearance_cleanup(changed)
